h1: The 7 Best Ice Makers Under $100 for Small Kitchens and Patios, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Ice Maker Under $100: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 countertop ice makers under $100, scored on daily output, cycle time, self-cleaning, handles and bullet ice size options.
summary: The Silonn Countertop Ice Maker is the best ice maker under $100, with a 6-minute cycle, 26 lbs of ice a day, self-cleaning, a carry handle and a basket and scoop. The EUHOMY with two ice sizes is the choice for variety, the EUHOMY with handle is the portable alternative, and the Frigidaire bullet maker is the brand-name option.
intro: Under $100, every countertop ice maker makes more or less the same thing: bullet-shaped ice at about 26 lbs a day. The listings look interchangeable, and the real differences hide in the small print: whether it cleans itself, whether it has a handle, how many sizes it makes and how loud the compressor gets. Those are the points that decide whether you keep using it in month three.

Seven machines are ranked below, all in the $50 to $100 bracket. They are scored on stated output, cycle time, cleaning features, portability and how much information the listing provides. Several listings are sparse, and we mark them down for it.

products.name: Silonn Countertop Ice Maker with Carry Handle
products.verdict: 9 cubes in 6 minutes, 26 lbs a day, a self-clean cycle, a carry handle and a basket and scoop.
products.description:
The Silonn produces 9 bullet cubes every 6 minutes, up to 26 lbs a day, with self-cleaning, a carry handle, a basket and a scoop.

It wins because it has every feature that matters at this price without a gap in the listing. The self-cleaning cycle matters most. Countertop ice makers hold standing water, and a flush routine keeps that from turning into slime. The handle lets you move it to a patio for a barbecue and put it away afterward.

Buy it if you want a complete, simple machine. Skip it if you prefer chewable nugget ice, which needs a different type of machine.
products.idealFor: Everyday ice for a small household.

products.name: EUHOMY Ice Maker Countertop with 2 Ice Sizes
products.verdict: Pick small or large bullet cubes, with a 6-minute cycle and a self-clean routine.
products.description:
This EUHOMY lets you choose between two bullet ice sizes, makes 9 cubes in 6 minutes, produces 26 lbs a day and includes a self-cleaning cycle, a basket and a scoop.

Size options are practical: smaller cubes chill a glass fast, and larger ones melt more slowly in a pitcher or cooler. It ranks second only because it lacks a carry handle, which the Silonn offers. Otherwise the specs are equal.

Buy it if you want to switch between cubes for glasses and bigger ones for drinks coolers. Skip it if you need to carry the machine.
products.idealFor: People who like both small and big cubes.
products.skipIf: You want to move it often.

products.name: EUHOMY Countertop Ice Maker with Handle
products.verdict: A black machine making 26 lbs a day, with auto-cleaning, a handle, a basket and a scoop.
products.description:
The black EUHOMY with handle turns out nine cubes per six-minute batch, around 26 lbs across a full day, and cleans itself; the basket and scoop come in the box.

It is a near-twin of the Silonn, which is why it takes third. Black hides fingerprints and sits well beside dark appliances. Auto-cleaning performs the same job as the Silonn's routine.

Buy it if you prefer the EUHOMY name or a black finish. Skip it if the Silonn is cheaper.
cons: Nothing sets it apart from rivals
products.idealFor: Buyers who like the EUHOMY name.

products.name: Frigidaire Countertop Portable Bullet Ice Maker
products.verdict: A portable bullet maker producing 26 lb a day in a black stainless steel finish.
products.description:
The Frigidaire portable bullet ice maker makes 26 lbs a day and comes in a black stainless steel finish.

A major appliance brand brings easier warranty claims and a familiar service network. The listing says little else: no cycle time, no cleaning mode and no accessories are mentioned. That sparse listing is why it ranks fourth despite the brand.

Buy it if you prefer a known appliance maker and a black stainless finish. Skip it if you want self-cleaning and accessories confirmed.
products.skipIf: You want a stated self-clean mode.

products.name: Antarctic Star Countertop Ice Maker
products.verdict: A compact countertop machine with a 6-minute cycle and 26 lbs a day.
products.description:
The Antarctic Star is a compact countertop ice maker with a 6-minute cycle and 26 lbs of daily output.

It is the better choice for a very tight counter, since compact is its main selling point. It sits fifth because the listing omits cleaning and accessory detail, and Antarctic Star is known mainly for budget cooling gear.

Buy it if counter space is scarce. Skip it if you want listed cleaning or accessories.
products.skipIf: You want more detail on cleaning.

products.name: Frigidaire EFIC128 Compact Countertop Ice Maker
products.verdict: A compact black Frigidaire making 26 lbs a day.
products.description:
The EFIC128 is a compact black countertop ice maker from Frigidaire, producing 26 lbs per day.

It shares the 26 lb output with the rest of the field and offers the Frigidaire name in a smaller body. The listing says nothing about cycle time or cleaning, and it trails the portable Frigidaire on mobility.

Buy it if you want a small, branded unit. Skip it if you want features listed.
products.idealFor: Small spaces with a brand preference.

products.name: NEWBULIG Countertop Ice Maker with Handle
products.verdict: A portable countertop ice machine with a carry handle and few listed specs.
products.description:
The NEWBULIG is a portable countertop ice maker with a carry handle.

It finishes last because the listing gives no output, no cycle time and no cleaning information. Handle and portability are the only listed facts, so you are buying blind compared with the other six.

Buy it only if it is much cheaper than the Silonn. Skip it if you want documented performance.
products.idealFor: Casual use at a very low price.

whatMatters.detail: Every machine here is rated around 26 lbs per day, roughly a pound an hour. That suits a household, not a party of thirty. Start the machine hours before guests arrive.
A 6 minute cycle yields nine cubes, so a basket fills over an hour or so. Machines with no cycle time listed make planning harder.
Standing water breeds slime. A self-cleaning cycle flushes it with a press of a button. You still need to empty and dry the unit when it is idle.
Two sizes let you choose small cubes for glasses and larger for pitchers. Most budget machines make one. It is a small feature that you notice often.
The compressor and fan make a steady hum. Place the unit away from your seating area and leave clearance around vents.

faq.q: Why does the ice melt in the basket?
faq.a: The basket is not refrigerated, so ice slowly melts and the water goes back to the reservoir. That is normal. Move ice to the freezer for storage.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake with a countertop ice maker?
faq.a: Leaving water in it for days. Stale water grows slime. Empty and dry the machine if you will not use it for a while.

faq.q: Is the Silonn worth it over the cheapest listing?
faq.a: Yes, because the listing documents a self-clean cycle, a handle and accessories. The cheapest options hide those details.

faq.q: How long until the first ice?
faq.a: About six minutes for the first batch of nine cubes, after the water chills. Full baskets take an hour or more.

faq.q: How often should I clean it?
faq.a: Run the cleaning cycle weekly if you use it daily, and descale monthly if you have hard water.

faq.q: Can it replace a freezer ice maker?
faq.a: For occasional use, yes. For heavy use, a 26 lb machine falls short.

finalTake: The Silonn Countertop Ice Maker is the best ice maker under $100, with a 6-minute cycle, 26 lbs a day, self-cleaning, a handle and a scoop. The EUHOMY with two ice sizes is the choice for variety, and the Frigidaire units suit brand loyalists. Avoid listings that hide output and cleaning details. Run the cleaning cycle weekly and the machine will last.
